title: Payroll: Preparation, Analysis and Management
overview: Payroll and employee benefits represent one of the most significant expenses for any organization, second only to the Cost of Goods Sold (COGS), rent, and depreciation. For companies where these costs are included in COGS or operational expenses, the impact is even greater. Accurate payroll processing and reporting are essential for financial analysis and effective decision-making. This course begins with an introduction to the HR, accounting, and finance functions, and then delves into the payroll process, covering preparation, calculations, and necessary controls to ensure data accuracy.
audience: This course is ideal for payroll staff, payroll accountants, accounting assistants, payroll supervisors and managers, HR professionals involved in payroll, and anyone interested in understanding and applying payroll best practices.
methodology: The course is designed with a blend of consultant-led presentations, practical Excel exercises on payroll and benefits, and interactive group workshops and presentations.
competencies: Budgeting for payroll and departmental expenses
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand the critical roles of HR, accounting, and finance in payroll management
Accurately prepare and review monthly payroll
Calculate employee benefits, loans, vacations, and End of Service Benefits (EOSB)
Reconcile payroll with accounting records and audit supporting documents
Develop monthly and annual payroll budgets
Create and analyze periodic payroll management reports
